state:
**Goal `ext-image-analysis` — `Novis\Image` compares, hashes, summarises and draws. Stages 2 to 5 are on disk. Stage 6 (the feature proofs) is nearly done.**

The design is ADR 0120 §§ 8 and 9, and the goal file's § *Standing decisions* answers every call a session meets. No session re-decides one.

Stage 6 on disk: `Image::hash`, `Image::hashDistance`, `Image::placeholder`, `Image::palette`, `Image::compare` and `QrCode::render` owe nothing. All four enums (`HashKind`, `PlaceholderKind`, `QrLevel`, `Align`) owe nothing, so check `dossier-novis-image-analysis-enums` should be green.

Still owed: `Image::text`, `Image::measureText` and `Font::fromBytes` each owe `about.md`, three examples, one attack and one bench (then `bun nv proofs --record-perf --only '<member>'`).

The font question is answered. `Core\IO` has no member that reads a file as bytes (`read` and `readText` return UTF-8 strings, `nvs agent show 'Core\IO'`), so an example cannot load a `.ttf`. Instead, a 332-byte TrueType font made for the examples lives as hex in a companion: `docs/examples/types/Novis-Image-Align/fonts/box-font.nvs`, class `BoxFont::load(): Font`. Every printable ASCII character is a box 0.6 × size wide (inked from 0.05 to 0.55), space is empty, ascent 0.8 and descent 0.2, so "Shop" at size 10.0 measures 24 by 10, and a wrapped second line starts 10 pixels down. Copy that companion into each text member's example folder as `fonts/box-font.nvs` (a subdirectory is not counted as an example, docs/examples/README.md § companions). A `.nvst` case or a bench inlines the same hex (see `tests/conformance/novis/image-align-places-each-line-in-the-text-box.nvst`).

`cargo deny check bans` fails on a `nvs-image` wildcard dev-dependency that was already there before this goal; `cargo deny check licenses` was not re-run for `ab_glyph` and its three crates (not checked).

items.text: **`Image::measureText`'s proofs** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`) — at `extensions/image/nvs/Image.nvs:260`; `docs/examples/types/Novis-Image-Align/01-where-the-short-line-starts.nvs` shows the font companion and a call that runs. `about.md`, three examples, one attack, one bench, then `--record-perf`. Run an example that requires a companion with the debug `nvs.exe run`, not `bun nv try` (playbook, *Running things*).

**`Image::text`'s proofs** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`) — at `extensions/image/nvs/Image.nvs:244`; same companion, same steps. An example prints what it can check, for example a row of pixels as `#` and `.`, or the size from `Image::info`.

**`Font::fromBytes`'s proofs** (`rule:testing/feature-proofs`) — at `extensions/image/nvs/Font.nvs:17`; it checks only the first four bytes and calls no export (`crates/nvs-cli/tests/image_analysis.rs:66`), so its examples and attack need no real font except one that draws.

backlog: `Core\IO` has no file reader that returns `bytes`, so a Novis program cannot load a font or an image from disk (`Core\IO` card). Not this goal's to decide; say so to the user if a later goal needs it.
`cargo deny check bans` and the `nvs-image` wildcard dev-dependency (`deny.toml`), and `cargo deny check licenses` for `ab_glyph` (not checked).
